column3: MT 40:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; the doubled “waiting I waited” is rendered “I waited patiently.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a pit of roaring” is rendered “the pit of destruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “a song of” before “praise.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Your plans” is rendered “Your thoughts,” and NASB supplies “If” and “would.”
“Offering” is rendered “meal offering,” and “ears You have dug for me” as “My ears You have opened.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the midst of my inward parts” is rendered “within my heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have borne news of righteousness” is rendered “I have proclaimed glad tidings of righteousness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Your faithfulness” is rendered “Your truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “troubles” is rendered “evils.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to snatch it away” is rendered “to destroy it.”
“And I am poor and needy” is rendered “Since I am afflicted and needy,” and “may He think of me” as “Let the Lord be mindful of me.”
